payload.goal: Register the supplier invoice from Océan SARL in Tripletex, creating the supplier first if needed, using expense account 6340 and deductible VAT 25%.
success_checks: Supplier Océan SARL with organization number 955986881 exists in Tripletex
Supplier invoice INV-2026-8825 is registered with invoice date 2026-06-27 and due date 2026-07-27
Gross amount is 75312 NOK and matches net 60250 plus VAT 15062
PDF is attached or referenced on the supplier invoice if supported
risk_notes: Company receiving the invoice is only stated as 'Ditt firma'; exact Tripletex company context must already be selected
Currency is implied as NOK/kr but not explicitly confirmed in structured fields
Supplier email and phone are missing
Supplier invoice registration may require a specific VAT code in addition to VAT rate
If Tripletex requires supplier bank account or payment terms fields, only bank account 36069835664 and due date are available
Need to ensure account 6340 is valid in the target company chart of accounts
ordered_steps: Check whether supplier with organization number 955986881 exists via supplier lookup endpoint
If missing, create supplier with name 'Océan SARL', organization number 955986881, address 'Torggata 92, 4611 Kristiansand', and bank account '36069835664'
Lookup account 6340 in chart of accounts and confirm it is active for expense posting
Lookup deductible VAT code matching 25% input VAT
Upload or store the PDF attachment if attachment endpoint is available
Create supplier invoice header with supplier reference, invoice number 'INV-2026-8825', invoice date '2026-06-27', due date '2026-07-27', gross amount 75312, and currency NOK if required
Add supplier invoice line for 'Skylagring' with net amount 60250, account 6340, and deductible VAT 25%
Attach the PDF to the supplier invoice record if supported
Confirm the supplier invoice is posted/registered successfully and has a Tripletex document ID

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.text:

1. Register a supplier invoice from Océan SARL
2. Create the supplier first
3. Use expense account 6340 with 25% VAT
4. Invoice details: INV-2026-8825, date 2026-06-27, due 2026-07-27, gross 75312 NOK

Steps:
1. POST /supplier - Create Océan SARL
2. GET /ledger/account?number=6340 - Resolve account ID
3. POST /ledger/voucher - Register the invoice with one debit posting

Let me create the supplier and resolve the account in parallel.
I'll follow the trace template: create supplier and resolve account 6340 in parallel, then create the voucher.

payload.headline: Supplier created correctly but voucher failed 5/6 scoring checks despite successful API call
what_went_wrong: Only 1/6 checks passed — the voucher structure or field values were incorrect despite the API accepting it. Likely wrong account (6340 vs expected), wrong VAT code, or missing due date/invoice fields.
First voucher attempt failed with 422 (postings don't sum to 0) because agent tried single-leg auto-split posting instead of balanced 3-leg manual posting.
VAT type ID 0 (exempt) was used on all postings including account 6340, which may have caused the deductible VAT check to fail — correct VAT type for 25% input VAT should be a specific non-zero ID.
The supplier invoice may require a specific API endpoint (POST /supplierInvoice) rather than a generic ledger voucher, which could explain multiple field check failures.
what_worked: Supplier Océan SARL created successfully on first attempt with correct org number, address, and bank account.
Agent correctly identified the need for 3-leg balanced posting (expense, input VAT, AP) after the first 422 error.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice endpoint instead of POST /ledger/voucher — supplier invoices likely have dedicated fields for dueDate, invoiceNumber, and supplier linkage that the scorer checks.
Use the correct VAT type ID for 25% deductible input VAT (likely ID 3 or similar, not 0) on the expense account 6340 posting to pass VAT-related checks.
Verify the expense account: the invoice description 'Skylagring' (cloud storage) may map to a different account than 6340 (Lys, varme = light/heat), causing account check failures.
unnecessary_calls: First POST /ledger/voucher with single-leg posting — agent should know balanced postings are required and skip this attempt.
GET /ledger/account for account 2710 and 2400 could be combined or cached if account IDs are known from playbook.
